fn-gps-01.front: Does phone GPS need cell signal?
fn-gps-01.back: No. The map tiles do, so save the area in Offline Maps first.

fn-gps-02.front: Typical phone GPS accuracy in open sky?
fn-gps-02.back: About 4.9 m (16 ft). Worse near trees, cliffs and buildings.

fn-gps-04.front: Where should the phone ride on a frosty morning?
fn-gps-04.back: Inside chest pocket, not the pack lid or hip belt.

fn-gps-05.front: Can you charge a frozen lithium battery?
fn-gps-05.back: No. Warm the phone and power bank first. Charging below freezing harms the battery (75%).

<rect x="0" y="0" width="400" height="300" fill="#fffaf0"/>

fn-gps-06.front: Why airplane mode in dead zones?
fn-gps-06.back: It stops the phone burning battery searching for a tower. GPS keeps working.

fn-gps-08.front: Why does Go & Track keep the screen awake?
fn-gps-08.back: iPhone web apps cannot record with the screen off.

fn-gps-09.back: Drop waypoints at the truck, glassing seat and bench with the screen off between.

fn-gps-14.front: Why lithium AA cells in the headlamp?
fn-gps-14.back: Rated from minus 40 to 60 degrees Celsius (75%). Alkaline weakens in cold.

fn-gps-15.front: Two is one, one is none: list the backups.
